instructions:
The full-resolution image is hosted at image.url in the first content entry (as JSON). Download the full-resolution PNG by running:

  curl -f -L -o image.png "https://www.figma.com/api/mcp/asset/b4316082-1869-4901-877a-ce1992ac328f.png"

IMPORTANT: The URL expires after 7 days. The user MUST download the PNG before the URL expires to keep a copy.
The URL returns raw PNG bytes (Content-Type: image/png).
Any inline image is a thumbnail preview (at most 256px per side), not the full-resolution image.
